title: 2024 AMC 12A Problem 9
statement: Let \(M\) be the greatest integer such that both \(M+1213\) and \(M+3773\) are perfect squares. What is the units digit of \(M?\)

solutions.text: Write \(M+1213=a^2\) and \(M+3773=b^2,\) so \(b^2-a^2=2560,\) i.e. \((b-a)(b+a)=2560.\) Both factors have the same parity, hence both even. To maximize \(a\) (and thus \(M\)), minimize \(b-a:\) take \(b-a=2,\ b+a=1280,\) so \(a=639.\) Then \(M=639^2-1213\) \(=408321-1213\) \(=407108,\) whose units digit is \(8.\) Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: \((b-a)(b+a)=2560\) with both factors even; to maximize \(M,\) make \(b-a\) as small as possible
